dataPolicy: Verified tournament results only; local scrimmages and friendlies are excluded.
editorialPhilosophy: Every team has a chance to be the story.
productTagline: The home of California youth water polo.

rankingDataReadiness.juniorOlympics: Not yet included; post-JO validation planned
rankingDataReadiness.preJORankingsPilot: 12U Boys v8; 12U Girls v3; 14U Girls v3; 14U Boys v2 metadata refresh; 16U/18U Boys/Girls v1
rankingDataReadiness.sameTeamAliasMerges: Expanded same-team alias layer applied to 12U Boys v7 and 14U Girls v3 pilots
rankingDataReadiness.singleGroupRankings: Rankings page renders one age/gender group at a time

rankingModelGuardrails.majorGirlsEvents: Futures Super Finals and US Club Championships are weighted as peer-level major events for girls rankings. Teams playing both receive higher confidence, not an automatic rank boost.
rankingModelGuardrails.commonOpponents: When teams did not attend the same major event, common opponents across Futures and US Club are used as ranking evidence.
rankingModelGuardrails.platinumD1: D1/Platinum teams anchor the top ranking bands. D2 teams can only cross lower D1 teams with strong evidence.
rankingModelGuardrails.teamDepth: A/B/C team depth and same-club hierarchy are applied before publication.
rankingModelGuardrails.girlsAliasCleanup: 14U Girls v3 applies manual same-team alias consolidation, including Lamorinda A/B/C correction, and holds under-5-game profiles from public rankings.
rankingModelGuardrails.girlsMajorEvents: Futures Super Finals and US Club Championships are weighted as peer major events for girls ranking groups.
rankingModelGuardrails.girlsCommonOpponentCrossover: 12U Girls v3 uses common-opponent crossover across Futures, US Club, JO Quals, and SD County Cup; SBWPC A was moved below the top 10 after D2/D1 validation review.
rankingModelGuardrails.d2MajorEventCeiling: Lower-division major-event wins can move teams upward, but they require D1 validation to enter the top 10.
rankingModelGuardrails.olderAgeExpansion: 16U and 18U groups use recent major-event weighting, JO Qualifier validation, division-tier guardrails, team-depth guardrails, and manual alias normalization.
rankingModelGuardrails.boys14URefresh: 14U Boys now carries the same Pre-JO metadata layer used by newer groups: team depth, division tier, game counts, major-event context, and review flags. Ranking order is preserved for this refresh.
rankingModelGuardrails.depthTeamReview: Depth-team review flags are generated for groups with 40+ teams, with special attention to B/C teams in upper bands and same-club ladder inversions.

logoSystem.status: verified bitmap logos normalized; placeholder SVGs retained until source art is provided
